chapter_title_en: The Winds Rise Overseas, Nishang Grass
chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality Ch. 401: The Nishang Grass Trap
chapter_meta_description: Han Li transforms Red Coral Island into a kill box using the 'Nishang Grass' and Heaven Vial. A masterclass in cultivation-world logistics and patient predation.
og_title: Setting the Perfect Ambush: Han Li's Botanical Kill Box
og_description: Han Li uses a forgotten herb and his Heaven Vial to create the perfect demonic beast trap, turning a failed cultivation-world scheme into a logistical masterpiece.
twitter_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality Ch. 401: The Botanical Trap is Set
twitter_description: Han Li engineers the perfect hunt by weaponizing a 'useless' spirit herb. The ultimate patience play in xianxia.

lore_anchors.definition: A spirit herb with thirteen curled leaves that emits a demonic-beast-luring scent every hundred years when a leaf unfurls. Also known as 'Demon Luring Grass,' it was abandoned by most cultivators due to its rigid growth cycle.
The former nickname for the Nishang Grass given after its scent's effect on demonic beasts was discovered; later abandoned by cultivators as impractical.
A legendary "Minor Forbidden Array" used by Han Li that specializes in illusion and concealment. It blocks one of the three paths to the island's center.
Han Li's mysterious treasure; its green liquid can accelerate the growth of spirit herbs, allowing him to bypass the century-long wait for the Nishang Grass's leaf-unfurling.
A pair of spirit beasts owned by Han Li, used to test the safety of the Nishang Grass's scent. They consumed the grass while under its influence.

A classical Chinese idiom describing a foolish farmer waiting for a rabbit to kill itself on a stump. Han Li subverts this into a calculated survival strategy by engineering the conditions for success.
